text:
Devon (partnerships): Heads-up  Nimbus batch PO hit a partial-accept from Azure marketplace. Two POs provisioned, one left in pending state. Customer already sees duplicate seat entitlements. Urgent. :scream:
Hannah (finance): Ack. paste the marketplace ack payload if you have it. we need PO ids for reconciliation.
Devon (partnerships): Portal ack (trimmed):
```
{"accepted":["PO-2026","PO-2027"],"pending":["PO-2028"],"rejected":[],"notes":"partial_acceptance_due_to_throttling"}
```
Marco (vendor success): Customer reporting double seats for PO-2026/2027. They turned on 200 seats and marketplace provisioned 400 (duplicate assign). They're furious.
Lee (eng - integrations): Quick take: looks like our outbound gateway retried the batch when the marketplace returned a 202/processing and marketplace later accepted the retry as new. We don't send an idempotency key per PO.
Ilya (eng): Tech option: add Idempotency-Key header per PO line (e.g., X-Idempotency-PO: sha256(PO-2026|timestamp)) and persist incoming ACKs atomically. Also add a reconciliation worker that compares marketplace acceptance before provisioning tokens. ETA ~3 days to rollout safe path.
Priya (legal): Legal note: if we deprovision seats after the fact we need clear customer communication and a documented remediation to avoid billing disputes. Any automated rollback must preserve the original acceptance artifact.
Hannah (finance): Also need a temporary invoice hold for the accepted POs until we reconcile. If double-billed we must apply credit. Who owns the customer comms?
Marco (vendor success): I'll take comms. Immediate ask: can partner-ops request Azure to collapse the partial accept and confirm final status for PO-2028? They may be able to mark PO-2028 as accepted or explicitly rejected so we can act.
Maya (partner-ops): Opening ticket MP-99999 -> "Partial acceptance + duplicate provisioning". MarketplaceBot: "MP-99999 created: partial batch acceptance detected. Partner review SLA 24h (escalated)."
Lee (eng - integrations): Short-term mitigation we can do today: block provisioning until marketplace returns 200/accepted for each PO id. Ilya can flip a feature flag to make provisioning conditional on explicit acceptance. Low-risk and reversible.
Ilya (eng): Yep I can gate provisioning by acceptance state and add a one-off reconciliation job that marks duplicates and issues deprovision for duplicates. Will need DB migration to track ext_ack_id per PO. ETA hotfix: 12-24h for gating + 72h for full reconciliation workflow.
Priya (legal): I'll draft a short customer acknowledgment and remediation note template confirming we'll hold billing and reconcile within X days and issue credits where needed. Need to loop-in compliance if government customers are affected.
Hannah (finance): Accounting ops: please implement invoice hold for PO-2026/2027 until reconciliation completes. I'll formalize credit terms.
Devon (partnerships): Plan: 1) Maya escalate MP-99999 and request immediate partner admin action to normalize acceptance; 2) Ilya -> gate provisioning on explicit accept (hotfix); 3) Lee -> add Idempotency-Key design + reconciliation job (3d); 4) Priya -> customer-facing remediation template; 5) Hannah -> invoice hold & credit plan; 6) Marco -> own customer comms. I'll follow up in 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
MarketplaceBot: "MP-99999 status: escalated -> partner admin engaged. Update expected in ~6h."
